title: Seven small Website Opportunities faults from the dev e2e run stay fixed: demo link, look-check and social stats in the ledger, unchanged Retry publishes nothing, demo chat session ids, unsourced contact details
steps: S1: list /ops/wo with a demo build whose site key is <label>.<siteDomain>.
S2: run the demo look check with a fake vision door and an account; summarise a demo-look ledger row on /ops Usage.
S3: fetch social stats through ScrapeCreators; then with the research daily cap at 0.
S4: research a place, then Retry one source that answers the same; then one that answers something new.
S5: hold a prompt for a wo-demo-<uuid> session; test the session id rule against good and bad ids.

S6: run collected-used on pages showing an uncollected email, mailto, phone, street line; on a page with a sample:true row about it; with a collected email beside a sample one; read agentDemoCollected's sample rows.
expect: S1: demoSite is the site key and demoUrl is http://<site key>:<port>/ with no second domain.
S2: the charge carries purpose demo-look, the builder as payer and the reported tokens; Usage counts it under demo-look, not other.
S3: one settled scrapecreators ledger row per request at 1 cent; with the cap at 0 no call goes out and the page waits as 'budget'.

S4: same answer: current snapshot unchanged, research key unchanged, logo research kept, request completed on the current snapshot; new answer: new snapshot that keeps the logo research's vision record.
S5: the wo-demo session is held and written to the file; ../, spaces, a leading dash and over-long ids are refused.

S6: each uncollected value is a COLLECTED_UNSOURCED finding; the marked sample is listed, not failed, only on its page; the sample beside a collected email fails; samples carry page and what the row is about.
fence: wo-ops demoUrl from the site key, demo-look's ledger purpose/payer/tokens, social-stats' per-request ledger reservation, publish()'s same-content check for one-source runs, sameLogoFindings, SESSION_ID's prefixes, checkCollectedUsed's COLLECTED_UNSOURCED with sample rows

tests: /ops/wo links a demo at its site key, which already carries the site domain
the call is charged as vision against the research caps, with what the answer says it used
the finished demo's look check is its own purpose, not 'other'
ScrapeCreators reserves calls against the matching network cap
a spent research daily budget defers the page like a spent provider cap
a Retry whose source answers the same keeps the snapshot, the brief and the logo research
a Retry that finds something new still publishes it, keeping the logo research it did not redo
Tracy's own session ids are sessions too; anything that is not an id is still refused
collected-used: an email, phone or street address the research never collected fails unless marked sample
collected for the final check: brief facts, every collected review, own photo count and imported paths
